reason: The pallet is buried, so using the winch there seems like a practical first step toward freeing the array.
expectation: I expect the winch to pull or loosen the pallet, though it may need another attachment first.

alternatives.reason: The service tool may open the shipping frame, but freeing the buried pallet seems more immediate.

effect: The array is recovered, but it needs stable feet before it can power the cabin. The shipping frame appears to provide the material.
reaction: I’m curious how the salvaged frame will support the panels on loose ground.
reason: The service tool and shipping frame are the only offered combination, and the result identified the frame as material for feet.
expectation: I expect to salvage parts from the frame for the array’s feet, though they may need further assembly.

effect: The frame has become metal stock, some of which can support the array while other pieces are reserved for workshop forming.
reaction: The distinction between the mounting feet and other stock makes me curious about what the workshop will make.
reason: Fitting the stock to the recovered array is the only offered combination and should help stabilize it on the loose ground.
expectation: I expect to make or attach broad mounting feet to the array, though further work may be needed to power the cabin.

effect: The array is now standing, so connecting it is the next step toward powering the cabin.
reaction: It is satisfying to see the salvaged stock make the array usable.
reason: The power lead is the only offered combination and seems necessary to connect the standing array to the cabin.
expectation: I expect the lead to connect the array to the cabin's power system, though another connection may be needed.

effect: The connection completed the cabin power goal and confirmed that the array can supplement the emergency battery.
reaction: The fan returning to its ordinary note makes the practical result feel tangible.

mostWorthwhile.text: Salvaging the shipping frame for wide feet was the most worthwhile part: it connected an available material to the problem of supporting the array on loose ground.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the power lead felt predictable because it was the only offered combination, although it provided a clear finish.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the shipping frame could supply both mounting feet and stock for later workshop forming.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; each had a clear connection to recovering, supporting, or connecting the array.

continue.text: I would choose to continue, partly to see what the remaining stock is used for and what else the expedition discovers.
